Mavericks Trackpad 2 is installed. Cursor, scrolling, and gestures work over both USB and Bluetooth.

If you were updating from an earlier version: the previous driver is still running, because a driver that is actively driving your trackpad cannot be replaced while it runs. Restart to finish — the new version loads at the next startup. Your trackpad keeps working in the meantime.

For the Trackpad preference pane — settings, battery level, and renaming the device — this installs a companion that System Preferences loads through SIMBL. If you don’t already have SIMBL, the trackpad itself still works, but the Trackpad pane will not show your trackpad. Install SIMBL from https://mavericksforever.com/downloads/SIMBL.pkg, then quit and reopen System Preferences.
